verdict.rationale: GlitchTip is a self-hosted error-tracking tool; being self-hosted implies the operator controls their own data, but no evidence explicitly addresses a telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out setting for GlitchTip itself (e.g., anonymous usage stats sent to the vendor). The MCP server 'no data sharing' claim relates to AI tool data flow, not product telemetry opt-out.
